pure-black.$description: Pure Black — Dark supporting neutral for text, icons, and strong contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Dark section backgrounds, footer, dark band surfaces

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary headings, dark surface text, nav text on dark

iron.$description: Iron — Muted body copy, descriptions, helper text

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary body text, de-emphasized paragraphs

steel.$description: Steel — Placeholder text, disabled states, input borders

fog.$description: Fog — Light muted text, icon strokes, subtle borders

ash.$description: Ash — Light dividers, icon strokes on light surfaces, nav borders

mist.$description: Mist — Hairline borders, card outlines, subtle dividers across all surfaces

cloud.$description: Cloud — Page canvas, default body background behind content bands

paper.$description: Paper — Elevated card surface, subtle inset panels, light section background

white.$description: White — Card surfaces, input fields, highest elevation surface, text on dark

glacier-tint.$description: Glacier Tint — Soft accent wash, highlight background behind emphasis spans, subtle selected state

badge-slate.$description: Badge Slate — Badge text and small-tag foreground

inter.$description: Entire interface — body copy, navigation, buttons, badges, cards, subheadings, UI labels

fraktion.$description: Hero display headline only — a single, custom, weight-700 face for the primary H1
